e.title: bnn-claims (BMDN)
e.summary: 个体理赔预测论文代码（kasaai，CAS 资助）：贝叶斯混合密度网络（BMDN）
e.body:
bnn-claims 是论文《Individual Claims Forecasting with Bayesian Mixture Density Networks》的仓库（kasaai，CAS 资助）：用贝叶斯混合密度网络（BMDN）对个体理赔做预测——混合密度网络输出完整分布而非点预测，贝叶斯化处理不确定性。对 RIAA：个体理赔预测（现金流的分布预测）的前沿深度学习方法。与 [[simulationmachine]]（个体理赔模拟）、[[deeptriangle]]（深度学习准备金）、[[drn]]（分布精炼网络）同属精算深度学习分布预测谱系。关联 [[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

**相关**：同一篇论文的 CAS 官方复现仓库见 [[rp-bnn-claims]]（产物不同源，属同一论文的两处代码）。

e.summary_en: Paper code for individual claims forecasting with Bayesian mixture density networks (kasaai, CAS-funded)
e.summary_hk: 個體理賠預測論文代碼（kasaai，CAS 資助）：貝葉斯混合密度網絡（BMDN）
e.body_en:
bnn-claims is the repository of the paper 'Individual Claims Forecasting with Bayesian Mixture Density Networks' (kasaai, CAS-funded): forecasting individual claims with BMDN — mixture density networks output full distributions rather than point predictions, and Bayesian treatment handles uncertainty. For RIAA: a frontier deep-learning method for individual-claims (cashflow distributional) forecasting. Joins [[simulationmachine]] (individual claims simulation), [[deeptriangle]] (deep-learning reserving) and [[drn]] (distributional refinement networks) in the actuarial deep-learning distributional-forecasting spectrum. Related: [[chainladder]], [[actuarial-pricing]].

**Related**: the CAS-funded reproduction repository for the same paper is recorded at [[rp-bnn-claims]]; the two artefacts are separate but belong to one paper.
e.body_hk:
bnn-claims 是論文《Individual Claims Forecasting with Bayesian Mixture Density Networks》的倉庫（kasaai，CAS 資助）：用貝葉斯混合密度網絡（BMDN）對個體理賠做預測——混合密度網絡輸出完整分佈而非點預測，貝葉斯化處理不確定性。對 RIAA：個體理賠預測（現金流的分佈預測）的前沿深度學習方法。與 [[simulationmachine]]（個體理賠模擬）、[[deeptriangle]]（深度學習準備金）、[[drn]]（分佈精煉網絡）同屬精算深度學習分佈預測譜系。關聯 [[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

**相關**：同一篇論文的 CAS 官方復現倉庫見 [[rp-bnn-claims]]（產物不同源，屬同一論文的两处代码）。
